title: Documents
loadError: Couldn't load the documents. Check that the server is running, then press Try again.
empty: No documents yet. Drag a PDF into a note to keep it here.
revealFailed: Couldn't open the folder of {{name}}. Please try again later.

text.low: Only part of the text could be read

low.sparse-text: Some pages have very little text (for example, pages with only pictures). Search and AI only read the parts with text.
low.too-large: The file is too long, so only its beginning was read.

none.no-text: It may be a scan. AI and search can't read this file.
none.encrypted: The file has a password. Save a copy without one to search inside it.
none.damaged: The file may be damaged. Try opening it with another app.
none.too-large: The file is too large to read its text.
none.timeout: Reading this file took too long, so it was stopped.
